items.docs:
Updates multiple facet fields.Maximum 100 items per request.

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - Edit

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"EDIT","targetId":"{trackingId}"} ```
